alan_cs: Handoff for Hawthorn private VPC. Networking and peering done. Two blockers: KMS decrypt failing for inference nodes and security wants signed confirmation of 730d immutable CloudTrail retention.
mina_se: Share the KMS error from their agent logs?
alan_cs: They returned: `AccessDeniedException: Not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:888777666555:key/aa22-bb33`. Occurs when service calls /v1/keys/unseal.
peter_kms: Likely key policy missing Redwood principal or no Grant. Ask whether CMK lives in their account. If yes, add our service role or create a grant.
ivy_net: Also verify node IAM role includes `kms:Decrypt` and `kms:GenerateDataKey`. IRSA issues common for EKS.
alan_cs: I sent them a minimal role policy snippet to attach. They also asked if enabling S3 Versioning is enough for immutability.
mina_se: Versioning + Object Lock (GOVERNANCE/COMPLIANCE) is required for provable immutability. If they want our attestation, we should only sign once Object Lock + versioning are enabled.
alan_cs: CS renewal note: security expects confirmation by Fri EOD; procurement may hold renewal otherwise. Marked 'at-risk' and scheduling a 30m call tomorrow 11:00 ET.
infra-bot: Reminder: onboarding checklist Hawthorn-#482 due in 72 hours.
alan_cs: Thanks team 10: I'll post the KMS checklist and a short attestation template after the call. Drop any quick clarifications here and Ill include them in the runbook. :white_check_mark:
